name: pr-highlighter
description:
Highlight lines by the GitHub PR that introduced them.

Usage: Open any file in a GitHub repo and press Cmd+Alt+H (Mac) / Ctrl+Alt+H (Windows/Linux), or run 'PR Highlighter: Toggle PR Highlights' from the Command Palette. Press again to clear. Hover over any highlighted line to see PR details.

Requires the gh CLI (gh auth login) or a GitHub token set in Settings under prHighlighter.githubToken.

commands.title: PR Highlighter: Add PR to Copilot Chat

prHighlighter.githubToken.markdownDescription: GitHub personal access token with `repo` scope. Leave empty to use the `gh` CLI auth token automatically.

prHighlighter.enableCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens with PR number above each PR's first line in the file.
